scope: Exact-input interrupted offline import recovery across all ten existing importer APIs and CLI commands
status: Qualified local implementation; not merged/published and not full P2-P6 parity

tests.note: After the full run, added a named malformed-journal regression, reproduced inherited unhashable-list TypeError, then added the string guard and ran the affected execution/recovery/workflow suites. Do not report1057 as a full-suite result.

review.verdict: PASS; no BLOCK in reviewed scope
review.mutations: Intent identity and preflight-before-mutation guards separately removed; each compiles, four discriminating assertions fail and six sibling controls pass.

behavior: Durable intent binds full profile, ordered prompts/responses and manifest including origin.
New-root default unchanged; explicit recover=True/--recover requires matching intent.
Validate existing state before creating missing profile/replies/import receipt; preserve completed bytes.
SIGKILL after temporary-file fsync and before profile/reply publication leaves recoverable staging; advisory lock releases on death.
Unknown remote-dispatch journal entries without replies remain refused; no network transport used.
Legacy recordings remain replayable; missing legacy intent cannot be adopted.
review_corrections: Close lock descriptors on all acquisition failures and retain stable inode without rewriting PID.
Preserve only recognized regular staging files from interrupted atomic writes; do not interpret/delete staged contents.
Compare canonical JSON identity rather than bool/numeric-coercing Python equality.
Reuse shared strict JSON; refuse duplicate keys, nonfinite overflow and dangling expected symlinks.
Malformed journal collection values produce typed refusal rather than an unhashable-type crash.
limits: Local macOS/POSIX filesystem evidence; Windows, network filesystem and power-loss durability unqualified.
Older PID-file and new advisory-lock protocols must not run concurrently on the same recording root.
Existing source/extraction/time-study import permission behavior is preserved: they do not themselves refuse denied export. Do not infer a new universal access policy.
No hostile concurrent filesystem mutation or provenance authentication claim.
Provider execution/retry, native timing integration, remaining study/algorithm/graph families and full P2-P6 remain owed.
